page.metadataDescription: Your current plan, usage and available upgrades.
page.title: Billing & Plan
page.description: See what your plan includes and what you have used this period. Upgrades and cancellations are handled by Stripe.

currentPlan.label: Current plan
currentPlan.starterHint: Choose a paid plan below to start a subscription.
currentPlan.manualHint: This plan has no Stripe subscription, so there is nothing to manage in the portal.

freeNote: You are within the free limits. Paid plans are optional; upgrade only when a limit is actually in your way.

checkout.cancelledDescription: You have not been charged and your plan has not changed.
checkout.confirmedDescription: {plan} is active. Your new limits are shown below.
checkout.processingDescription: Your payment is processing. This page will update shortly. You will not be charged twice if you refresh.
checkout.confirmingDescription: Stripe has sent you back, but the payment confirmation can take a few seconds. Your plan will update here as soon as it lands.

usage.title: Usage this period
usage.description: Counters reset automatically at the date shown. Existing work is never deleted when a quota runs out.
usage.exhausted: Quota reached — generation is paused until reset or upgrade.
usage.endOfPeriod: at the end of the period

credits.title: Monthly credits
credits.note: Generations reserve credits before they run and settle at the actual cost when they finish. If something fails, the reserved credits come back to you.
credits.emptyDescription: Activity appears here when a generation settles or a new cycle is granted.

errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.invalidInput: Some fields are invalid. Check them and try again.
errors.offline: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Billing is not configured on this deployment yet. No payment was started.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Try again shortly.

notice.paymentFailedDescription: We could not confirm your latest payment. Update your payment method to keep your plan and quota.
notice.cancelledDescription: Your {plan} plan stays active until {date}. After that it changes to {starter} and paid limits stop.
notice.trialDescription: Your trial ends on {date}. You will keep {plan} after that unless you cancel.
notice.endOfBillingPeriod: the end of the billing period
notice.portalDate: the date shown in the portal

cancellationScheduled: Cancellation is scheduled. You keep {plan} until {date}. <link>Choose a plan to continue</link>.

generation.creditSuffix: Top up or upgrade in Billing to continue.
